text:
Ana Morales: tiny ask for launch week 1 026 webinar + socials: need hero tile (latency vs cost), two 1:1 socials, and a keynote-ready slide. accessible + brand compliant. first drafts by Wed Eod.
Lina Chen: on it. confirm metrics to surface: p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token?
Mike Patel: yes. use p50 + p95 for latency, tokens/sec, and cost/token. will provide sample numbers.
Mike Patel: numbers: Hosted p95=320ms tokens/sec=150 cost/token=$0.0009; Dedicated p95=180ms tokens/sec=420 cost/token=$0.0006; Private p95=210ms tokens/sec=380 cost/token=$0.0005.
Ana Morales: headline idea: "Serving wins: lower cost, reliable latency". also need a conservative copy layer for APAC/legal.
Kate Rivera: brand: Approved Blue #0A6CF0 for accents, logo clearspace rules apply, AA contrast min. supply SVGs + flattened PNGs.
Design-Bot: figma starter: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/bench-keynote-stub. export notes: hero 1200x630 PNG @2x, micro 1080x1080 PNG, slide 1920x1080. include alt text.
Lina Chen: design Q: bars for hero or sparkline?
Ana Morales: bars — quick scan. add optional 1:1 micro infographic: "cache + batching = lower cost".
Jordan Lee: CTA routing: slide CTA -> form tag "bench_webinar_2026" + utm_campaign=bench_launch. I'll patch routing when assets land.
Lina Chen: posting first frames Tue EOB. will add dark-mode slide, reserved 300x150px code area, and layers: conservative_copy + motion_opt.
Mike Patel: will add sample query snippet for the code area.
Kate Rivera: will review brand compliance after frames posted. ping me for visual QA.
Ana Morales: thanks all 1. please drop figma links and screenshots here for review.
